sourceReconsideration.finding: Re-established 38 unique components and 180 EC across three 60-EC years. The neutral stakeholder track and regulated minor/electives route remain justified independently of UCR fit. The project is counted once. Entry rules and capacity limits are accurately qualified.

courseReconsideration.finding: BENBUSI112 supplies substantive financial and management accounting and discounted cash-flow appraisal. BENBUSI312 supplies securities, markets, banking and risk with a bank simulation. Economics and econometrics provide economic mechanisms and empirical inference. Mathematical statistics, numerical methods, algorithms and optimisation contribute actual decision methods; no finance-specific assignment is presumed. International governance, strategy, public economics and ethical argument supply specific context. The result is a coherent related financial-markets/quantitative-decisions programme with explicit international-accounting, multinational-tax and complete-track gaps. Broad business and technical AI routes retain their separately justified priorities. Description-only evidence was fully considered within its limits.

interestFinding: All 37 target rows and 14 generators remain accounted for: seven core, three AI, two finance and two responsible-business generators. Further-master entrepreneurship examples remain search-only. No personal student profile was invented.
alignmentFinding: All 38 external components, 39 UCR course identities, 15 positive partial relationships and 23 meaningful gaps were reconsidered. Workforce psychology, finance and enterprise-AI relationships have bounded claims. The marketing cell now describes documented digital marketing, branding, customer journeys and consumer research. Optional research remains 15 EC outside each 24-course/180-EC programme, beside the single required 7-EC external project.
coherenceAndDistinctness: Three concepts satisfy substantive alignment, coherence and current academic feasibility. The pairs differ by 8, 11 and 10 courses, with changes in academic priorities rather than cosmetic substitutions. The third is justified by actual financial institutions and decision methods, not by a quota or asserted specialist equivalence.
